# qualys fixtures

SYNTHETIC, hand-made Qualys VMDR scan report CSV (`vm-scan-report.csv`)
with a title block, QID 86002 Results cells in the OpenSSL-style
`(n)name<TAB>value` layout, another QID, a row without serial, a bad port
and a short row. Re-record from a real scan report of a lab; the Results
layout, the serial format and whether fingerprints are printed must be
confirmed then.
